data.name: Colony
data.detailed_description:
Colony is a real-time strategy game about two ant colonies fighting over one meadow. You don't steer every single ant - you lead the colony: decide whom to hatch, where to gather, what to research and when to strike. Build a strong economy first, and your warriors will do the rest.

Grow your colony

  • Workers carry food home - from plants, and from mushrooms once you learn how.

  • Architects carry wood. Without wood there are no warehouses, traps or warriors.

  • Warriors guard the colony against enemies and wild creatures and go on attacks.

  • Build the Laboratory to unlock technologies and warriors, and warehouses to house more ants and give your gatherers a closer drop-off point.

  • Mark collection zones to tell the colony where to gather.

A living meadow

Plants seed, sprout and ripen. Food that nobody gathers grows into wood - and wood that nobody takes slowly rots away. Use the Forestry mode to leave plants to grow into wood on purpose. Ponds with lilies, streams with log bridges, swamps, stones, fallen snags and four kinds of mushrooms shape every map, and both halves of the field are mirrored, so neither side gets a better start.

Wildlife that doesn't take sides

  • Spiders catch ants in their webs - and from the cocoons new young spiders hatch.

  • Ground beetles live in the snags and chase every ant that comes too close.

  • Praying mantises lie in ambush and even wade through the stream.

  • Water striders steal the loads of ants walking along the water's edge.

  • Red ants are a neutral colony: they leave you alone until you attack them. Then they hold a grudge and raid your workers. Destroy their nest, and its whole food store is yours.

  • Snails crawl out of ponds and streams and eat the food growing on the shore. Send workers to gnaw them - the bigger the snail, the richer the meal.

Caves

Mysterious caves hide treasure - and danger. Send ten workers or architects inside: they may bring back a heap of food or wood, come back empty-handed or vanish without a trace. Each cave can be explored only once, and the enemy explores them too.

Technologies and automation

Research faster plant growth, quicker ants, mighty warriors, the flanking maneuver, self-growing stores, extra warehouses, mushroom gathering and mushroom farming. Automation technologies let the colony place zones, leave plants for wood, hatch ants, set traps and choose when to attack all by itself - so you can focus on the big decisions.

War of the colonies

Send your warriors straight at the enemy or around the edge of the field to strike from the flank. Put poison traps on the enemy's trails. Choose whether your warriors attack everyone or leave the wildlife alone. The colony left without workers and food loses.

Play your way

  • Four difficulty levels - from a peaceful Explorer mode, where the enemy never attacks, to Hard.

  • Four map sizes and world settings: stones, swamps, snags, ponds, streams, caves, wildlife and mushrooms - few, normal or many.

  • Fog of war - or the whole map in view.

  • A Lot Of Resources mode for a fast, rich game.

  • Detailed end-of-match summary and charts.

  • 22 Steam achievements.

  • Music that follows the course of the match.

  • Rebindable hotkeys.

data.short_description: Two ant colonies, one living meadow. Gather food and wood, grow your colony, explore caves, research technologies and send your warriors to destroy the rival nest - while spiders, mantises and red ants have plans of their own.
data.supported_languages: Inglês, Francês, Alemão, Espanhol (Espanha), Polaco, Português (Brasil), Russo, Turco, Ucraniano

[/th] [/tr] [/table]


[u][h1]A short-term strategy about the life and rivalry of ants. [/h1] [/u]
The concept is simple and intuitive. The implementation is a bit lacking in polishing, but this game is definitely worth its little money.

 [h1]Gameplay: [/h1]
Your anthill is fighting for resources with a neighboring anthill. 
In the end, only ants from one colony should remain on the map.

 [h1]To win, you need: [/h1]
[olist]
[*]properly manage resources,
[*]to understand at what point in time what is better to buy, build and what technology to study.
[*]choose the best places for buildings and speed up logistics.
[/olist]

There is no tutorial, but since the variety of options is not too large, then after a few experiments, you yourself will understand what's what.

[h1]The game contains: [/h1]
[olist]
[*] three types of ants,
[*] two types of resources,
[*] three types of buildings.
[*] slightly more than ten technology options.
[*] traps.
[*] options for automatic and manual control of different settings.
[*] convenient hot keys.
[/olist]

 [h1]Two main game modes: [/h1]
[olist]
[*] with a lot of initial resources.
[*]with a minimum amount of initial resources.
[/olist]
 [h1]Length of games and willingness to replay: [/h1]
[olist]
[*] I have already played over a hundred matches and it is still interesting for me to return to this game sometimes.
[*] Despite the initially seemingly small variety, the game has a lot to experiment with. Just from the one in which part of the map you start and build your buildings, a lot is already changing.
[*] Average time per game: [b]10 minutes to an hour[/b]. Depending on the mode and style of play.
[*] If desired, it is possible to start fighting from the first minute. And if you already have enough experience, it is possible to win quickly and finish the game in 5-10 minutes.
[*] It is possible to block the creation of warrior ants. Then the game can drag on significantly. I had some games for over an hour.
In this case, the game may have a meditative, unhurried look. And you are just enjoying your huge ant colony.
[/olist]

[h1][+] Advantages: [/h1]
[olist]
[*] Very good low price for a real time strategy.
[*] It is possible to play many times.
[*] Everything is intuitive.
[*] Various options for the game: from very fast fights with manual control, to long meditative observation of automatic development.
[*] Music and sound effects are normal. For more than a hundred hours of playing, I am not tired of it yet. The melodies are calm and meditative.
[*] The developer answers, gives advice, listens to feedback.
[/olist]

[h1][-] Disadvantages:  [/h1]
[olist]
[*] The first few games you will most likely be beaten by artificial intelligence, since there is no tutorial and you learn from your mistakes.
[*] Get ready to be defeated by AI at first.
Many players get frustrated and stop playing after the first couple of games. But the most interesting thing begins after you play a dozen times with different modes and game settings.
[*] The game is not very polished. If desired, there is a lot to find fault with, improve and add variety. But then the game would have cost much more.
[*] You learn some of the game's functions by chance only with time. For example, that pause is the Escape button. To remove the menu during the game, you need to right-click on it.
[*] No game mode against other players.
[*] English only. Although, even without knowing the language, it is possible to understand everything intuitively soon.
[*] No music mute button. Although, personally, I did not need this and I was not looking for this button.
[*] The maximum window magnification may not fill the entire window for some monitor resolutions.
[*] It is much easier to play when you learn the hotkeys. There are less than ten of these keys.
[*] After playing for a while, you may want to continue developing the plot and increasing the variety. But what do you want for such a small price.
[/olist]

 [h1]Conclusions: [/h1]
This little game is definitely worth its little money.
The game can be liked by those players who will not compare it with the well-known strategies and who will be happy to play it for only one or two evenings.
This can be a game that allows you to relax and take a short break from big, complex games.
The concept of the game is simple, understandable and many players will want to develop this ant theme deeper.


UPDATE:
After writing this game review, I started writing suggestions for improving the game to the developer. And the developer asked me to help him. And now we began to work together on updating the game, which I hope we will finish soon.
Therefore, now you can see that the review was written by the developer.
